name: HeaderStatsBar
description: Horizontal flex strip that hosts the dashboard's stat boxes (HeaderMinersBox, HeaderHashrateBox, HeaderConsumptionBox, HeaderEfficiencyBox). Lives inside `<AppHeader>` as the middle slot
descriptionFull:
Horizontal flex strip that hosts the dashboard's stat boxes (HeaderMinersBox, HeaderHashrateBox, HeaderConsumptionBox, HeaderEfficiencyBox). Lives inside `<AppHeader>` as the middle slot.

Slot-based: the caller decides which boxes to render and in which order. The bar interleaves an angled chevron divider between adjacent children

props.name: children
props.description: Stat boxes to render in order, left-to-right
